title: Badal mein bhi sunburn kyun? UV sensor ka sach ☀️ #shorts
description:
Badal ho to bhi sunburn kyun lagta hai? UV-A ozone se ruke bina zameen tak pahunchti hai.
ML8511 sensor wahi UV pakadta hai, aur voltage mein badal deta hai.
☀️ Sensor 280-390 nm light pakadta hai
⚡ Output 1 V (no UV) se 2.8 V (15 mW/cm2) tak
🔌 3.3 V reference aur 8 readings ka average lo
🧪 Ye raw UV intensity hai, official UV index nahi
Echo Lab 3D ko subscribe karo, aur sensors kholke dekhte hain!
